Inner West Local Environmental Plan 2022
The Inner West Local Environmental Plan 2022 outlines building height controls, floor space ratios, setback requirements, and parking requirements for various types of buildings and zones.

Floor Space Ratio Controls
Floor Space Ratio Controls specify the limits on the total floor area of buildings relative to the area of the block, with different limits for various zones.

Residential Buildings
Residential buildings are defined within the environmental plan as structures that must not exceed building height controls of 8.5 metres.

R1 Zone
R1 Zone is a residential zone subject to specific floor space ratio controls with a maximum FSR of 0.6:1.

Mixed Use Zones
Mixed use zones refer to areas designated in the environmental plan where both commercial and residential activities can occur, with specific building and floor space ratio controls.

Parking Requirements
Parking Requirements dictate the minimum number of parking spaces required per dwelling unit and visitor parking regulations.

R2 Zone
R2 Zone is another residential category defined within the environmental plan, also with a maximum floor space ratio of 0.6:1.

B4 Zone
B4 Zone refers to mixed-use zones with a maximum floor space ratio of 1.2:1 as stipulated in the plan.

Commercial Buildings
Commercial buildings in mixed-use zones are limited to a height of 12 metres according to the plan.

Setback Requirements
Setback Requirements define the minimum distances that buildings must maintain from property boundaries, including front, side, and rear setbacks.

Height Controls
Height Controls refer to specific regulations that limit the maximum allowable heights for residential and commercial buildings within the Inner West Local Environmental Plan 2022.

Community Contribution Schemes
Community Contribution Schemes may allow for additional floor space ratio (FSR) in exchange for contributions to community projects, as mentioned in the plan.
